{{Otheruses|Bean}}
'''Polta beans''' were a type of [[Legume/Legends|legume]] that could be cooked into a gruel. [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], would sometimes cook polta beans. She notably did so when [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] joined her meal at some point in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="IE">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>
